related.title: osquery：差分紀錄重建與初始快照邊界
related.titleEn: osquery: differential reconstruction and initial-snapshot boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付10列變更區間、掃描真值矩陣、可見率與基準核准鏈，說明這不是現場效能測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver ten change intervals, scan truth matrices, visibility and baseline approvals, explicitly identifying the synthetic scope.
related.difference: 以完整列tuple為狀態鍵，保存初始快照與有序差分，區分版本欄改動和物件真正消失。
related.differenceEn: Use full row tuples as state keys, preserve an initial snapshot and ordered deltas, and distinguish version changes from object disappearance.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 排程掃描只能比對取樣時刻的狀態；本課比例是給定時間線可見率，不是產品普遍偵測率。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 掃描在0與300秒；10項變更皆從120秒開始，其中6項持續到360秒、4項在180秒還原。 300秒掃描看見6項，樣本可見率6/10=60%；4項還原不代表從未發生。
新狀態=(舊狀態−removed)∪added；只有確認基準與差分未缺漏時才能重建完整狀態。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 初始有8個套件tuple；一次更新移除2個舊版本tuple並新增其2個新版本，加裝1個新套件。 結果有8−2+2+1=9個套件tuple；不能把3筆added都稱為新安裝。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scheduled scans compare sampled states; the resulting fraction belongs to this fixture, not universal product detection performance. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Scans occur at 0 and 300 seconds; ten changes begin at 120, with six lasting to 360 and four reverting at 180. The 300-second scan sees six changes, yielding 60% fixture visibility; four reverted states do not imply no changes occurred.

New state is (old−removed) union added; complete reconstruction requires an established baseline and no missing deltas. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. The baseline contains eight package tuples; an update removes two old versions, adds two replacements and installs one new package. The result has nine tuples; the three added rows do not represent three newly installed packages.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Timesketch：保存查詢版本與反證可重現性
related.titleEn: Timesketch: versioned searches and reproducible counterevidence
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付10列變更區間、掃描真值矩陣、可見率與基準核准鏈，說明這不是現場效能測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver ten change intervals, scan truth matrices, visibility and baseline approvals, explicitly identifying the synthetic scope.
related.difference: 建立包含查詢、選取時間線ID、時間範圍、欄位與匯入雜湊的搜尋規格；分開列出命中列數與原始事件唯一數。
related.differenceEn: Create a search specification containing query, selected timeline IDs, time bounds, fields and import hashes. Report matching rows separately from unique original events so collaborators can reproduce the exact scope.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 排程掃描只能比對取樣時刻的狀態；本課比例是給定時間線可見率，不是產品普遍偵測率。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 掃描在0與300秒；10項變更皆從120秒開始，其中6項持續到360秒、4項在180秒還原。 300秒掃描看見6項，樣本可見率6/10=60%；4項還原不代表從未發生。

Timesketch的儲存搜尋與時間線協助重現分析；來源重複匯入不會製造第二個現實事件，事件身份應由明確來源鍵建立。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 A有40個命中事件，B有30個，其中10個與A同源；再匯入A副本40列。原始身份由source_id加record_offset組成。 原始命中列70，唯一事件40+30−10=60；加入A副本後110列但仍60個唯一事件。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scheduled scans compare sampled states; the resulting fraction belongs to this fixture, not universal product detection performance. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Scans occur at 0 and 300 seconds; ten changes begin at 120, with six lasting to 360 and four reverting at 180. The 300-second scan sees six changes, yielding 60% fixture visibility; four reverted states do not imply no changes occurred.

Timesketch saved searches and timelines support reproducible analysis. Importing a source twice does not create another real-world event; define identity with explicit source keys rather than row position. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Timeline A has forty matching events; B has thirty, ten sharing identities with A. A duplicate import adds forty rows. Define original identity as source_id plus record_offset. The initial result has seventy rows and 40+30−10=60 unique events. Adding the duplicate A import increases rows to 110 while the unique-event total remains sixty.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
